# AI instructions for Text Game Records

Before adding, resuming, editing, or narrating a game in this repository, **read `AGENTS.md` and `rules/AI-START-HERE.md` first**, then `rules/manifest.json`, `rules/complete-rulebook.txt`, and `rules/npc-causality-v1.0.txt`.

Always identify the exact game ID and read that game's latest `state.json` and `history.json`. Follow the user's selected worldbook **original**, not an unrelated game's summary. Do not conflate game #001 with #002.

The protagonist's dialogue, actions, thoughts and decisions belong to the user. Check every NPC's source of knowledge, rank awareness, physical location, responsibilities and reason to speak. Avoid unnecessary back-and-forth, contrived incidents and filler alerts. Correct invalid details in the correct game records without inventing retrospective events.

The public site alone does not automatically provide AI context. Do not claim to have read files you did not access.
